name: optic
desc: In a real fly, first vision: photoreceptors feed lamina and medulla columns splitting motion, color and form, projecting to AVLP/PLP and navigation. Simulated version: The sim's vision lives here: light assays drive the photoreceptors and their direct visual targets, and knocking those out blinds the fly. Finer cell types are mapped, not modeled.

name: ME
desc: In a real fly, main visual relay; motion, color and form columns (Mi, Tm, T4/T5 dendrites). It sits in the optic system. Simulated version: part of the optic-lobes group; the sim's vision runs through the photoreceptors and their direct visual targets instead, and light assays move those. On effect maps it reports as medulla.

name: LO
desc: In a real fly, feature detection; lobula columnar output to AVLP/PLP (escape, object vision). It sits in the optic system. Simulated version: part of the optic-lobes group; the sim's vision runs through the photoreceptors and their direct visual targets instead, and light assays move those. On effect maps it reports as lobula.

name: VNC

Simulated version: The motor cord and legs: every walk the fly takes runs through here, and toxins that freeze the body show up in its firing.

name: olfactory
desc: In a real fly, smell learning and instinct: antennal-lobe glomeruli split into mushroom-body Kenyon cells for learned value and lateral-horn neurons for innate responses. Simulated version: The sim's smell lives here: banana finding, repellent effects fading stage by stage, and anosmia when the nose neurons are silenced.

name: AL
desc: In a real fly, first smell; one glomerulus per receptor type, PNs relay onward. It sits in the olfactory system. Simulated version: the first smell relay is a measured stage — cards read its projection neurons live, and a repellent's effect lands here first. On effect maps it reports as antennal lobe.

name: LH
